findings: Verified: retrospective-plan.ts readSessionSnapshot hashes original bytes, validates parent-before-child graph structure, computes safe cuts and pending tool calls; validateCompleteToolCalls refuses unfinished source batches before conversion/model work.

Verified: index.ts completeRewind reconciles continuity and checks projected savings/headroom before branchWithSummary; failure handling attempts to restore the leaf and remove its label. Potential defect: restoration errors are swallowed, so the failure notice could coexist with a moved leaf.
Verified: continuity-store replay is branch-local and corrupt snapshots preserve the prior ledger; current-screen.ts createUserOpsWriter only permits writes while idle and capture is enabled.

Verified: index.ts buildContextMessages uses the edited session projection, invalidates stale usage, freezes summary-request context at the instruction, and maps failed rewind outcomes to tool-result errors. Potential risk: raw-projection fallback may bypass context-edit behavior; no failure was established.
Verified: continuity-ledger.ts rewindLedger preserves revision and ID high-water marks across rewind; proposal flow hashes and rechecks source and writes plans exclusively with mode 0600.
Verified: proposal inputs validate complete tool-call batches; auto-navigate configuration strictly parses bounds and merges partial model overrides.

Verified: extensions/navigate-tree/index.ts rewindStaleReason detects compaction after a rewind call; planEnding filters context edits to active-branch entries, and pending rewinds freeze instruction context while failed attempts are hidden.

Potential risk: auto-navigate.ts evaluateAutoNavigateTurn may omit older anchors when the evidence budget fits only tail records, potentially declining a rewind; this is not established as a runtime failure.
Verified: extensions/navigate-tree/index.ts planWithhold reprojects proposed context edits and applies none if recovery remains infeasible.

Verified: extensions/navigate-tree/retrospective.ts cloneRetrospectiveSession stages files exclusively with mode 0600, validates the clone, rechecks source/descendant hashes and family before publication, and attempts rollback. Cleanup failures are reported as warnings; potential residual is leftover staged temporary files, not a verified defect.
Verified: docs/architecture.md states folds preserve abandoned branches and continuity is fail-open.
